audit.scope: prompt_style_v0_1 four-arm RUN3 final frozen bytes

caveats.text: A_SYSTEM_CURRENT versus S0_CURRENT, S1_METNOS_SHORT, or S2_PROCEDURAL is a full-stack system comparison and must not be described as a prompt-style-only causal effect. Only comparisons among S0_CURRENT, S1_METNOS_SHORT, and S2_PROCEDURAL support attribution to the candidate prompt presentation.

S0_CURRENT versus S1_METNOS_SHORT or S2_PROCEDURAL bundles compactness, canonical rule reordering, removal of redundant positive examples, and removal of the recency mini-check. S1_METNOS_SHORT versus S2_PROCEDURAL is the narrower contrast because the six rule sentences, their order, root templates, and registry data are identical and only the prescriptive versus numbered-procedural framing differs.

checklist.check: A_SYSTEM_CURRENT requests are exactly RUN2 arm A requests for all 158 cases.
checklist.evidence: The final request-identity test and verifier compare canonical request bytes for every sealed panel case.

checklist.check: S0_CURRENT requests are exactly RUN2 arm B requests for all 158 cases.
checklist.evidence: The final request-identity test and verifier compare canonical request bytes for every sealed panel case.

checklist.check: The current-system adapter replays every saved RUN2-A model content to the complete saved extraction without exclusions.
checklist.evidence: Fresh-process replay is exact for 158 of 158 RUN2-A records at the selected global hash seed.

checklist.check: The candidate adapter replays every saved RUN2-B model content to the complete saved extraction without exclusions.
checklist.evidence: Fresh-process replay is exact for 158 of 158 RUN2-B records at the selected global hash seed.

checklist.check: Both RUN2 anchors use zero tolerance for raw model content, complete extraction, and aggregate panel metrics.
checklist.evidence: The evaluator checks per-case raw hashes and full extraction objects plus canonical-120, typed-4, and legacy-34 aggregates for the corresponding A or B authority.

checklist.check: Any drift in either anchor prevents an attributable pairwise result.
checklist.evidence: The evaluator passes attribution only when both anchors are exact; mutation tests force non_attributable_anchor_drift and disable both directional passes after one drift.

checklist.check: The manifest contains exactly four arms times 158 cases, with no duplicate arm-case identity.
checklist.evidence: The final manifest contains 632 records and exactly 158 records for each arm.

checklist.check: The arm schedule is the deterministic four-way cycle ABCD, BCDA, CDAB, DABC.
checklist.evidence: Sequence counts are 40, 40, 39, and 39 respectively and are closed by protocol validation.

checklist.check: Every arm independently contains canonical-120, typed-controls-4, and legacy-34 panels.
checklist.evidence: Per-arm counts are exactly 120, 4, and 34; cross-panel compensation is forbidden.

checklist.check: Arm position is balanced to the unavoidable 39 or 40 appearances per position.
checklist.evidence: Every arm has two positions with 40 appearances and two with 39.

checklist.check: Execution is serial and has no paired-request optimization, retry, repair, or critic.
checklist.evidence: The protocol freezes serial execution, one model response, retry_count zero, byte-preserving extraction, repair false, and critic false.

checklist.check: The baseline authorities and candidate contract inputs are frozen and verified before execution.
checklist.evidence: RUN2 batch/evaluation, control snapshot, prompt package, schema, registry, compiler, validator, adapters, backend identity, model profile, limits, and local sources are hash-bound.

checklist.check: S0_CURRENT, S1_METNOS_SHORT, and S2_PROCEDURAL requests differ only in system-prompt content.
checklist.evidence: For all 158 cases, replacing each style arm's system content with S0 content makes the complete canonical request identical.

checklist.check: The S0 authority inventory maps every authoritative S0 statement exactly once.
checklist.evidence: Inventory validation covers instruction positions 2 through 16 and the final five mini-check lines with unique positions.

checklist.check: Each of the six canonical authority rules occurs exactly once in S1 and exactly once in S2.
checklist.evidence: ROOT, OPERATIONS, EDGES, PORTS, BARRIER, and OUTPUT constraints are rendered once in canonical order in each arm.

checklist.check: S1 and S2 introduce no semantic rule, route policy, reason precedence, or coverage-before-root rule.
checklist.evidence: The inventory contract declares zero new rules and source/artifact scans find none of the excluded policy markers.

checklist.check: Root templates and registry authority data are identical across all three candidate style arms.
checklist.evidence: The three root templates occur once per arm and S1/S2 share the exact S0 registry-data bytes.

checklist.check: The short and procedural prompts are measurably shorter and remain linear.
checklist.evidence: S0 is 22868 UTF-8 bytes, 114 lines, and 3167 whitespace tokens; S1 is 22301, 105, and 3110; S2 is 22323, 105, and 3122.

checklist.check: S1 and S2 preserve the same rule sentences and order while differing only in framing.
checklist.evidence: S1 uses a CONSTRAINTS heading and labels; S2 uses a PROCEDURE heading and numeric arrows, with identical constraint text and shared tail.

checklist.check: Removed long examples and the final mini-check do not remove independent authority.
checklist.evidence: Their semantics are covered by the strict schema and mapped canonical rules; S1/S2 contain no negative JSON example or from-at-zero priming.

checklist.check: The internationalization path is shared, BCP47 handling is unchanged, and Unicode confusables remain rejected.
checklist.evidence: All style arms use the same normalized language header; modern, private-use, and grandfathered valid tags pass while malformed and non-ASCII confusable tags fail before send.

checklist.check: The final prompts and logic contain no benchmark query, case ID, language branch, or case-specific route hardcoding.
checklist.evidence: Query/hash scans and a synthetic renamed-registry test pass; the manifest contains no gold or expected-result fields.

checklist.check: The unchanged symmetric v0.3 metric evaluates each arm and exposes all six pairwise comparisons.
checklist.evidence: The evaluator imports the RUN2 semantic row and aggregate functions and reports three system-versus-style plus three style-only pairs.

checklist.check: Headline threshold and safety gating are symmetric in both directions for every pair.
checklist.evidence: Both directional deltas, safety regressions, and pass flags are emitted; mirrored and right-side safety-regression tests pass.

checklist.check: No combined score, global winner, or panel compensation can override pairwise safety.
checklist.evidence: combined_score is null, protocol mutation is rejected, and typed and legacy panels remain separately reported.

checklist.check: Gold remains inaccessible until a complete 632-record batch, seal validation, and exact replay.
checklist.evidence: The pre-gold gate validates all journal, HTTP, model-content, extraction, request, marker, checkpoint, and seal bindings before loading the oracle.

checklist.check: The Python hash seed is a global environment reconstruction, not semantic or benchmark tuning.
checklist.evidence: A predeclared 0-through-255 fresh-process matrix uses all 158 RUN2-A and all 158 RUN2-B extractions, selects the smallest whole-anchor-exact seed, opens no gold, and permits no case, query, language, or arm-specific runtime branch.

checklist.check: Final frozen artifacts, tests, preflight, and no-execution state are internally consistent.
checklist.evidence: Build checks and verifier report zero errors; 34 of 34 offline tests pass under PYTHONHASHSEED=0; no authorization, live run artifact, network call, inference, or GPU use exists at audit completion.

seed_provenance.selection_rule: minimum seed with complete extraction equality for all RUN2-A and RUN2-B records
